card.story: FICTIONAL EXAMPLE - Quarry DB (an invented open-source database) is said to be changing its license
card.user_knows: Saw one angry post on Monday

origin.what: Pull request renaming LICENSE to a source-available text

claims.text: A pull request proposing a source-available license was opened in the main repo
All past releases will be relicensed
Only releases from 9.0 onward change; 8.x stays under the old license

beats.what: Forum thread says every version goes closed

sides.position: Cloud resellers profit without contributing; the new terms only bind hosted resale from 9.0.
Contributions were made under the old terms; changing them without a vote breaks trust.

heat.topic: Whether a community fork will start

watch.what: Maintainer call where the PR is scheduled for decision

would_change: Any statement from the foundation that holds the trademark
headline: A license change is proposed, not merged; the company says it only affects 9.0+, and the 'every version' story traces back to a single forum post.
